ideas.pitch: A spatial-temporal forecasting tool designed specifically for college campuses that predicts safety bottlenecks and crowd congestion using Poisson regression and historical campus event data.
ideas.title: CampusAI Guard: AI-Campus Incident Forecasting & Predictive Safety
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the host venue (SNS College of Technology's AI Campus) by solving a problem judges and organizers feel daily on campus, matching winning patterns from predictive hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and meal recommendation platform tailored to student hostel diets, generating personalized wellness plans and reducing food waste in college canteens.
ideas.title: AuraHealth: AI-Driven Campus Mess & Nutrition Optimization Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a 24-hour hackathon winner by delivering understandable coding, practical health utility, and immediate consumer impact for students.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring tool to track unauthorized industrial expansion and environmental regulation violations around regional industrial zones.
ideas.title: GeoAudit AI: Satellite Monitoring for Local Industrial Compliances
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies heavy computer vision and real-world compliance tracking, aligning with hackathon wins that solve difficult technical verification problems.

ideas.pitch: A localized logistics and ride-sharing app that groups nearby college volunteers to safely transport elderly residents or disabled students to essential appointments.
ideas.title: CampusLink: Community Volunteer Driver & Senior Mobility Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages clear measurable social impact and straightforward coordination logic that judges can instantly evaluate during a 24-hour presentation.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined patient acquisition and feedback-processing platform designed for local clinics to automate intake forms and build digital patient trust securely.
ideas.title: TrustVerify: AI-Powered Trust and Patient Intake Engine for Local Dental & Medical Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear, quantifiable economic value for local businesses, emphasizing presentation quality and understandable coding required by the judges.
